class.name: KomsoftGwNode
class.brief_description: Pump driver for the [KomsoftGw] leaderboard singleton.
class.description: [KomsoftGwNode] advances the [KomsoftGw] singleton's queued and in-flight requests once per frame while it is inside the scene tree. It holds no state of its own — all configuration and actions live on [KomsoftGw]. Add a single instance to your scene (typically at startup) so leaderboard calls made anywhere in your game actually progress. [codeblock] func _ready(): add_child(KomsoftGwNode.new()) # drives processing KomsoftGw.configure(url, "pingpal", key, user_id) KomsoftGw.connect("score_submitted", self, "_on_submitted") KomsoftGw.submit_score("weekly_highscore", 4200) [/codeblock] See [KomsoftGw] for the full API.
